summative_rubric.title: Math in My Community — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: End-of-unit rubric covering C4 at community scale.

rows.expectation_text: apply the process of mathematical modelling to represent, analyse, make predictions, and provide insight into real-life situations

levels.descriptor: Cannot identify a community situation or ask a math question.
With prompts, walks through 2-3 of the 5 modelling steps.
Independently walks through all 5 modelling steps with a coherent community topic.
Walks through all 5 steps with community-scale numbers and a refinement based on the data.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to the Lesson 5 capstone evidence.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 1 row.

image_placeholders.description: A printable summative rubric grid in B&W on a landscape letter page. 5-column grid with 1 row (C4).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image AS_RUBRIC: keywords (rubric, levels) name the grid.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Community Model
summative_task_script.purpose: End-of-unit summative integrating all 5 modelling steps for C4.
administration_steps: Walk through the Capstone Modelling Template.
Circulate; prompt children with too-small topic.
Score: 4 of 5 steps complete = L3; 5 of 5 with refinement = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent community topic (out of 2) + 5 steps complete (out of 5) + refinement quality (out of 3) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C4: Capstone shows situation, question, data, prediction, reflection at community scale.
